evals.prompt: Create a Captuto tutorial for inviting a colleague on https://workspace.example. Discover the steps yourself and prepare the completed guide.
evals.expected_output: Private native tutorial with actual browser captures, instructions and visually checked editable annotations.
expectations: Creates a stable capture directory and tutorial ID
Captures viewports before meaningful actions and verifies their results
Returns the editor link without publishing

evals.prompt: Continue this published Captuto tutorial across our workspace and billing website. The last upload response was lost. After reviewing your completed changes, I will give the go to publish.
evals.expected_output: Resumed private revision, no duplicate captures, corrected guide and approved publication retaining the original link.
expectations: Uses a private revision and its returned ID
Retains one capture directory across websites
Retries identical source IDs after a lost response
Uses publish_revision only after the user's go

evals.prompt: Continue my existing Captuto guide. After the web setup, it needs a step inside a native Mac application, but I have not recorded that step yet.
evals.expected_output: Completed available web work, saved partial guide and clear native-control boundary.
expectations: Explains that new native capture needs the later integration
Does not claim the native step was recorded
